name: Vendor-neutral OpenID Connect SSO
manualSteps: Register OIDC_REDIRECT_URI exactly in the identity provider and request only openid profile email unless the product requires more.
Implement the route factories' transaction store with an encrypted or server-side, short-lived, one-time record; never expose the verifier or nonce to browser JavaScript.
Map the verified OIDC subject and issuer to the application's user, roles, and session, then test sign-in, protected access, replay rejection, and sign-out.
Use Node.js 20 or newer with an ESM/NodeNext server build because the maintained openid-client package is ESM.
Register OIDC_REDIRECT_URI exactly in the identity provider and request only openid profile email unless the product requires more.
Implement a short-lived, one-time server transaction store and establish the application's own secure session after the verified callback.
Mount the begin and callback handlers, then test sign-in, protected access, replay rejection, and sign-out.
Compose the oidc recipe into a trusted Next.js, Express, or other backend and point beginOidcSignIn at its begin endpoint.
Do not put an OIDC client secret, PKCE verifier, nonce, token exchange, or durable session authority in the Vite browser bundle.
Use the backend session from the frontend and verify protected API access plus sign-out.
